title: Listening & Speaking for Beginning English Language Learners
provenanceNotes: Self-declared high-beginning integrated-skills book; chapter pages carry CC BY 4.0 (LibreTexts metadata license:ccby/licenseversion:40). Chapter 1 'Greetings and Introductions' was inspected in full: Preview → Listen → Comprehension Check → Speaking staging per cycle; 1.3 Grammar attests the I am→I'm contraction table and 'complete these sentences with your own information' practice pattern (Practice 4: 'Hello! Nice to meet you. My name is ___'). Its broader content mixes countries/spelling/email/phone beyond the Lesson 001 target and its speaking activities require classmates. Role in SE Lesson 001: ADAPTED — supplies the contraction explanation and the own-information cloze frame; staging also referenced. No verbatim text copied; its listenings are embedded players (not redistributable audio).
